limits: A failed declared settling gate is retained as a failure. No coefficients, Q bits, activity epsilon or limits were changed to rename it a pass.
Zero/one stationary-body centroid polls at failure do not establish coupled settling or uniquely identify the numerical cause. These finite runs do not prove permanent instability.
Both field layouts have identical tree/counts/physics/parameters and different native field records. Different trajectories are allowed; no same-tick global solve is required.
The two moving fixtures share a category: a failing two-level case skips its three-level case. Other categories, including letters, continue; any failure keeps nonzero exit.

Independent long-double force reference; velocity reference conditioned on verified native force; Q position reference conditioned on verified final native velocity. Comparison error bounds never select live activity.
Actual retained Program LLVM, all selector/packet paths and negative controls; no executable-disassembly or CUDA-ordering claim.

Manifest charges host/native copies and identities. Known native metrics and linked C++ allocation guards exclude arbitrary malloc, drivers, page faults and complete process memory. Host vectors are unpinned.
Per-node work diagnostics never schedule. One existing native activity set per type, one visit/publication per poll, two complete publication slots and no per-depth ordinary solve.
Fixed opt-in actual x64/f64 trial. No structural refresh, operational owner/admission/contact transaction completion, database writes, cache-manager or analyst work.
